text: Oh! Hello there! Welcome to my crater. Would you mind terribly if I vaporized you?
Goodness, a visitor! Please, make yourself comfortable. This won't take long.
Ah, you must be the new target, partner. Lovely to meet you! Shall we begin?
Pardon me, I was just resting my eyes. Right then. Time to blast you, if that's all right!
Pardon me, would you mind holding still so I can vaporize you? Thank you so much!
You're doing wonderfully! Truly. It's a shame I have to flatten you.
Mind the dust, it gets everywhere. So will you, in a moment!
Oh, please don't run off. It's ever so rude, and I'm only trying to destroy you.
My mama always said, be kind to guests. Then blast 'em into orbit.
Would you care for a snack? Sunflower seeds? No? More rockets, then!
I do apologise for all the explosions. Actually, no, I don't. Sorry!
Such a lovely day on Mars for a polite little obliteration, don't you think?
Charging up! This might tingle. Quite a lot, actually!
One electric ball, coming right up! Do try to catch it with your face.
Zap delivery for you! Sign here, please. Oh, never mind, it's already there!
Hold still, I've charged it just for you!
Heads up! Well, heads down, really. It's a cluster bomb!
A little present from my slingshot! Lots of little presents, actually!
Ready, aim, fling! Y'all mind the bits!
I've been practising my aim. Please be a good sport and stand right there.
Excuse me, you're standing a bit close. Let me fix that! Whack!
Personal space, please! Thank you ever so much!
Oh dear, you've come too near the slingshot. That's on you!
Coming through! Mind your head, I'm swinging!
Ow! Well, that was uncalled for!
Oof! My whiskers! How very rude!
Ouch! I'll say, that one actually stung!
Hey! I just had these goggles polished!
Eep! Please stop that, it's terribly impolite!
Oh dear, oh dear. I may have underestimated you. Just slightly.
I'm not losing, I'm just... resting my thrusters. Very hard.
Right. Gloves off. Well, I don't wear gloves. But you know what I mean!
Right! That's quite enough of that. Double thrusters, if you please!
You've made me cross. And I am never cross! Full power!
I was being nice before. I'm still being nice. Just faster!
Oh! Oh my. Well played. Mighty well played indeed, partner...
I suppose I'll just... sit down here for a bit. Good game!
You win! Do take my weapons. I insist. Mind the sharp bits!
Oh no, did I break you? Sorry! Not sorry. Come back any time!
Thank you so much for visiting! Do come again so I can do that again!
There we are! All tidied up. Lovely!
Oh, bad luck! Better luck next time. There won't be one, but still!
